title: Education Spending Trend (2014‑2019)
subject: Economics
caption: Education spending as a percentage of GDP from 2014 to 2019, showing a modest rise and later stagnation.
altText: A flowchart timeline illustrating education expenditure percentages for each year: 2014 (2.8%), 2015 (2.9%), 2016 (3.0%), 2017 (3.0%), 2018 (3.1%), and 2019 (3.1%). The diagram starts with a 'Start' node, progresses through each year, and ends with an 'End' node, highlighting a gradual increase followed by stagnation.
